correctness.rationale: PASS: The exact prior A and B sharp frame bounds for the normalized two-sided exponential were checked directly against Faulhuber–Shafkulovska Eq.(8.1), and uniqueness/localization against Theorem 2.7. Algebraic factorization κ=cosh(x)coth²(η/2)(1+u/b)/(1-u/a) with x=η/q is correct. On the known η~log q optimizer interval, uniform elementary expansions give logκ=η²/(2q²)+4(1+η)e^-η+controlled smaller terms and derivative η/q²−4ηe^-η+smaller terms. Solving the exact stationarity equation gives e^-η=(4q²)^−1(1+O(log²q/q²)), hence the claimed position and three coefficients. Independently optimized exact analytic formulas for q up to 2048 corroborate the rate. Finite numerical tests do not prove uniform remainders; that follows from the stated controlled elementary expansions.

value.rationale: PASS: Optimal frame stability at high redundancy is a natural nontrivial quantity for a standard totally positive window. The logarithmic displacement of the optimal rectangular sampling lattice and its sharp excess condition number quantify conditioning and distinguish optimal from naive choices; they are stronger than simply recomputing known finite-q formulas.

final_claim: For normalized g(t)=exp(-|t|) with integer rectangular Gabor redundancy q→∞, the unique condition-number-minimizing lattice side satisfies ηq=2 log(2q)+O(log(q)^2/q^2), and the optimal condition number equals 1+[2 log²(2q)+2 log(2q)+1]/q²+O(log^4(q)/q^4).
